availableSettlementTime.description:
List of the all available settlement times based on the settlement date above.
If Settlement Availability is No, then this will not be provided.

settlementAvailability.description: A flag to indicate if there are any available times based on the settlement date provided.

settlementDate.description: The settlement date provided in the request which will be used to check available times.

times.description:
Available settlement time (in UTC) for the date provided.
If Settlement Availability is No, then this will not be provided.
Result set will be ordered by time ascending.
